why: creates the `/rosout` publisher (`rcl_interfaces/msg/Log`, absolute topic) on a node; NULL QoS takes the bounded VOLATILE profile, which needs no transient-local slot. Upstream has no such call because rcl creates that publisher itself; here the application does, since a publisher is a declared ENTITY (see `c:logging_rosout_enabled`). Part of the `/rosout` bridge from C (issue 1589, `<rclc/rosout.h>`); the Rust twin is `nros::rosout`. Links in every image and answers `RCL_RET_UNSUPPORTED` without the `rosout` capability.
